hints.title: Running Total
hints.text: Accumulate the prefix running total where each position equals the sum of all elements up to that position.

hints.title: In-Place Accumulation
hints.text: Iterate from index 1 to the end, adding the previous value nums[i - 1] to current element nums[i].

hints.title: Formula
hints.text: The recurrence nums[i] += nums[i - 1] transforms the array in linear time and constant auxiliary memory.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing sums from index 0 for each index takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single forward pass in-place achieves optimal O(N) time and O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes a clean single-pass in-place or new-array prefix accumulation.
